name: Dionysius of Rhodes
bio: Dionysius of Rhodes is one of the epigrammatists whose short poems were gathered in the Greek Anthology. Paton's index of authors gives no date for the poet. Paton's index lists the poet among the writers of Meleager's Wreath, the Garland compiled about 100 BC.
This archive carries the 1 epigram ascribed to the poet in the second volume of W. R. Paton's prose translation (Book VII: 716).

poems.title: Book VII, 716
poems.author: Dionysius of Rhodes
poems.text: Too early and missed by all us who dwell in the city of Ialysus, hast thou sunk, Phaenocritus, into the sea of oblivion, after plucking for a brief time the flowers of wisdom; and round thy tomb the very owls that never shed tears lamented. No singer shall ever sing as thou didst to future generations as long as men walk upon their feet.
